title: capture-launch.ts writes fixtures without care: it overwrites an existing pinned fixture silently, joins an unchecked --slug into the output path, stamps every capture expectedVerdict "safe", and clamps --window to 10 blocks although its header says an archive key widens it

evidence.note: mkdirSync + writeFileSync to test/fork/fixtures/realLaunches/<slug>.json with no existence check
slug comes from --slug unchecked (only the symbol-derived default is sanitised at :398), so --slug ../../x writes outside the fixture folder
expectedVerdict: "safe" and discoveredVia: "etherscan" are constants for every capture
effectiveWindow = min(window, 10) always, while :32-35 says a PAYG/archive endpoint allows wider windows
when no Mint is found within 50 blocks, mintBlock null is written without a warning

sibling_sites_checked: The only other fixture writer under scripts/ is none (addLiquidity.ts and deploySepoliaTest.ts write src/addresses.json, AUD-SCRIPTS-001). The replay test does not read expectedVerdict (git grep expectedVerdict under test/ at the base: only the anti-rug fork test and the honeypot fixtures, not realLaunchReplay), so the constant is narration only. The script never reads PRIVATE_KEY (it loads .env but only uses RPC URLs) and checks chainId 1 (:365-369).
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene: operator-run, read-only on chain; a wrong or overwritten fixture is visible in git diff.
recommendation: Phase 29 (HYG-03): refuse to overwrite an existing fixture without --force, validate --slug like the derived slug, drop or compute expectedVerdict, and make the window clamp follow the endpoint (or fix the header).
